answer: Each identity binds to one distinct verified blood donor, checked at an accredited centre in its karst district: staff scan photo ID, log a violet donor card, and post only its hash. Donors cannot give again for 56 days, so one person cannot ripple through many accounts. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 distinct eligible donors, about $28 travel and 2 hours each per cycle ($28,000), plus a 5-coin bond lost per reused donor or failed screening.
